setup.text: A sealed chest of unknown manufacture washes up after a storm.

a1.text: Inside are ordinary scraps and a strange metal fitting.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: The contents are ruined, leaving only questions.

b1.text: The chest becomes an object of scholarly fascination.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: Some villagers resent withholding a potentially useful resource.

c1.text: The chest disappears beneath the waves.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: A child wonders whether its owner will ever find it.
